title: Console list views other than the grid (kanban, calendar, gallery…) still draw every bare bulkActions name as a selection-bar button, declared or not, after #30169
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cb5R6JDdfyvtj3dPR2

Category: ① product defect with a named location. ⛔ Not a claim. Carries the out-of-scope half of #30169; #30169 keeps the grid (`ui/packages/plugin-grid`), fixed in PR #30387. Found by #30169's executor (os-dev-report 6654001061) and confirmed on the head by the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review 6654355327, which judged it a follow-up card, not a must-fix there.

**Business reason.** #30169's ruling C (comment 6651753071): "The selection bar draws only actions the object declares. An undeclared bare `bulkActions` name draws nothing, and in development the console logs one warning naming it." After PR #30387 the grid follows it, but a list shown as a non-grid view still draws a button for a name the object does not declare, including an action a disabled package withholds, and pressing it toasts "not executable". Same defect as #30169, one more surface.

**reach:** read on the PR #30387 head, not reproduced in a browser: `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` ~:7333-7375 draws every `permittedBulkActions` member by `tActionLabel(action)` with no resolution against the object's served actions (the grid path delegates to `ObjectGrid` ~:4403-4504 and is covered by #30387).

**Expected.** The non-grid bulk bar applies the same rule as the grid: a bare name draws only when the served object declares an action of that name (promoted with its label), `delete` keeps its own path, and an undeclared name draws nothing with the same one development warning. Reuse the grid's resolver rather than a second copy.

**Reader.** `domain:ui`, `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` plus pins; serial behind PR #30387 (it adds `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/undeclaredActionNames.ts`, which this card should reuse).

**Duplicate search** (open and closed): `permittedBulkActions` 1 hit (#30169 itself); `bulk ListView non-grid undeclared` 3 hits, none on this surface.
